document.title: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations
document.credit: Adapted from the paper by Alpöge and Buckmaster. Prepared by Will Cook with AI assistance.

notes: The introduction follows the whole-space and periodic constructions from the similarity profile, the finite-dimensional correction and the cutoff to the two gradient estimates.

Section 7 groups the certificate inequalities by their use in the proof and explains how the parameter choice cancels the added force. Appendix C distinguishes the computed profile, the approximate family and the exact profile.
The Lean comparison records the assumptions of the checked results and identifies the quantitative torus statement as open in the linked formalization.
